demo.title: peer-workflow.sh
demo.code:
# Live fiat<>USDC quote - no credentials needed
npx -y peer-protocol-cli quote --from USD --amount 100 --platform wise

# Market data
npx -y peer-protocol-cli market spreads
npx -y peer-protocol-cli market volume

# Cash out USDC to fiat: run the cash MCP profile
npx -y peer-protocol-cli mcp --profile cash
# peer_cash_estimate -> peer_cash_prepare -> sign with your wallet -> peer_cash_finalize

setup: No install or credentials for reads: `npx -y peer-protocol-cli quote --from USD --amount 100 --platform wise`
Remote read-only MCP (97 tools, no auth): https://mcp.peer.xyz/mcp
Cash-outs: run `npx -y peer-protocol-cli mcp --profile cash`; it prepares unsigned Base transactions your wallet signs and submits
